agency.name: Virgin Islands Department of Health — Division of Behavioral Health, Alcoholism and Drug Dependency Services (BHADDS)

narrNote: No U.S. Virgin Islands affiliate appears on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates, fetched and read in-run 2026-10-22). Left null — never inferred.
notes: BHADDS is the territory's single state agency division for substance use; NASADAD's SSA listing gives the division page used here, which fetched 200 in-run. The phone shown is the VI Department of Health St. Thomas office number published across doh.vi.gov; DOH also publishes St. Croix (340) 718-1311 and St. John (340) 776-6400. stateCrisis URL is VIDOH's official 988 announcement (fetched 200); VIDOH ran a 2025–26 procurement to stand up a local certified 988 call center, and until it is operational VI 988 calls route through the national network. two11 null: no 211 service was identified for the U.S. Virgin Islands in-run. peerOrgs empty: no territory peer/recovery community organization with a verifiable official website was found in-run (searches surfaced mainland Virginia NAMI chapters, not a USVI organization). medicaidSud URL is the VI Department of Human Services site (rendered in-run); DHS administers the territory's Medical Assistance Program (Medicaid). countyDirectory null: the territory has two districts (St. Thomas–St. John and St. Croix) and the BHADDS page serves as the service listing.
